notes: New York calendar-month trade allowance for every instrument. A newly submitted order with any fill consumes one slot; partial reports on that same order do not consume additional slots.

Review once each model session after its reference minute. At most one new order per session; all unfilled orders must be confirmed cancelled before a replacement. Crypto orders are also cancelled before New York month rollover in this replay.
At each review the FULL outstanding cash target is used, with optional cash constraints and instrument rounding. It is never divided by the monthly limit, unused slots, or three.

Five installments means five exogenous equal cash arrivals across the month, independent of the monthly limit. It is not an allocation rule for the calculator. Actual user/CCD deployment histories are not inferred.

All candidates, immediate reference execution, and a fixed 25 bp limit receive identical cash flows, limits, fees, and instrument filters. Cash carries within each task month. Unspent cash is reported and valued at month-end, never fabricated into a fill.
Cost is terminal wealth shortfall relative to immediate reference execution with the SAME trade limit, divided by the month's cash contributions. Completion and trade counts are reported separately.
Adaptive offsets are quantiles of drawdowns from strictly prior completed sessions, clipped to 5-500 bp. Lookback changes the price distance, not order sizing. No rung spacing is optimized.

Walk-forward selection uses six completed months before each scored month; both cash-arrival scenarios receive equal weight. The final partial month is never a scoring month. Missing required minutes exclude that whole task month for all policies and break training continuity.

ETF prices are indexed spot proxies, not historical ETF quotes. Hypothetical fees/penetration/partial-fill assumptions are sensitivities, not calibrated fill probabilities. Current static exchange filters are used.

This is retrospective research, not untouched prospective evidence. Paired monthly block intervals are exploratory and are not adjusted for scanning many limit/instrument profiles. No automatic production promotion or schedule change. Existing frozen experiments remain unchanged.
